capabilities: Scan configured vault folders for plugin folders and zip/tar archives and batch-install them
Install plugins from remote URLs or GitHub Releases links
Show a confirm-before-install card with manifest, compatibility and changelog
Back up the previous plugin version and install atomically via a temp directory
Configure release channels (stable or pre-release) per plugin
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it also states it works offline with no GitHub API dependency.
problem: Installing plugins normally requires copying files into .obsidian/plugins manually, which is hard on mobile and offers no review of manifest, compatibility or changelog before the files land.
summary: Plugin installer that installs Obsidian plugins from local folders, zip/tar archives, URLs or GitHub Releases, with a confirm-before-install review card.
